## Summary

I help customers work out what's actually possible, and what's actually feasible,
then build a small proof of concept that shows them it works. That's the part of
the job I like most, and it's taken me somewhere new every few months for close to
a decade.

The environments are usually the awkward kind. Kubernetes onto a submarine,
air-gapped because there's no bandwidth underwater. A border control platform I
supported from a secure room. Gene therapy pipelines demoed straight back to the
customer that cut projected analysis costs by 80%. Lately it's machine learning: a
multi-agent platform for drug discovery, and fine-tuning Google's MedGemma to
generate radiology reports from breast scans it had never seen.

I know these systems well enough to build the thing under pressure and explain it
at any level, from the code up to the business case. SC cleared, 12 AWS
certifications, London.

## Experience

### Machine Learning Consultant — Independent {#consulting}

*July 2025 – present*

ML engineering and advisory for early-stage startups: multi-agent systems, LLM
tooling, and MLOps.

### Machine Learning Engineer — BioX AI

*July 2025 – December 2025 · London*

- **Multi-agent drug discovery platform.** Deployed multi-agent workflows on Vertex
  AI Agent Engine using Google ADK, with A2A for inter-agent communication.
- **Agent tooling.** Built agents for literature review, patent drafting and
  experiment planning; integrated MCP tools for real-time literature and patent
  search.
- **Vertex AI training.** Fine-tuned Google's MedGemma on DICOM breast scans to
  generate radiology reports, evaluated against BI-RADS scores as ground truth.
- **MLOps & infrastructure.** Provisioned reproducible GCP environments with
  Terraform, set up cost tracking, and monitored agent runs with Agent Engine
  tracing and logs.

### Machine Learning Engineer — The Machine Learning Institute

*May 2025 – July 2025 · London*

Accepted into the ML Institute AI Residency — chosen from 800+ applicants for a
fellowship fully funded by the UK government, focused on moving applied deep
learning from research into production.

- **RLHF with PPO.** End-to-end RLHF pipeline for summarisation: reward model
  training, PPO from scratch (token-level KL divergence, reward shaping, advantage
  estimation), and parameter-efficient fine-tuning with LoRA/adapters.
- **Whisper emotion detection.** Fine-tuned OpenAI Whisper to classify emotions and
  environmental sounds, using token-based training that mixed pre-training and new
  data to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
- **Vision transformer captioning.** Built a synthetic dataset and trained a
  ViT + transformer decoder for image captioning with CLIP-style loss.
- **Dual-encoder retrieval.** Trained dual- and cross-encoder architectures with
  contrastive loss for semantic document retrieval; deployed with a Redis vector
  DB for ANN search.
- **Foundational work.** Implemented Word2Vec and custom transformers from scratch.

### Senior Consultant, Solutions Architect — HeleCloud (a SoftwareOne company)

*April 2022 – June 2024*

- Deployed a Terraform-based AWS Landing Zone into customer environments,

- Led 10+ AWS Well-Architected Reviews end to end, running multi-day workshops with

- Migration specialist for 10+ AWS Optimisation and Licensing Assessments. Deployed

  customer access constraints, with workload data encrypted locally before syncing
  to S3.
- Analysed 30 days of collected workload data to produce rightsizing and licensing
  migration recommendations, reducing TCO by 36%.
- Built cross-account AWS Security Hub aggregation with filtered critical alerts and
  Microsoft Teams integration.
